title: Three Voices: code and artifacts for Uncertainty-Gated Rendering of a Maternal-Health Risk Alarm
description: Three Voices renders one maternal-health risk prediction as three action signals: a decomposition for a clinician, a referral card for a community health worker, and a three-lamp visual with one spoken Hindi sentence for the mother. The work uses only the public UCI Maternal Health Risk dataset and makes no claim to predict real patients' outcomes; no user study has been run.
